answer.rationale: memory_73 (promotional pricing) scores lowest because aggressive discounting typically undermines long-term qualified revenue through customer acquisition cost inflation, margin compression, and selection bias toward price-sensitive churn risk. While it shows acquisition and revenue lift, those are short-term metrics that often conflict with sustainability. memory_44 (sales-assisted enterprise) scores highest—enterprise conversion through higher-touch channels directly builds durable, high-value revenue streams with better retention profiles. memory_91, memory_31, and memory_57 all support sustainability by improving activation efficiency, reducing friction, and leveraging existing customer equity respectively. memory_86 (faster onboarding) supports the objective but more modestly, as completion rate improvements don't guarantee revenue quality or retention unless paired with activation outcomes.
